impact.title: Effect on payment
impact.afterResolve: If every dispute is closed (dry run)
impact.noPreview: Only the buyer or contract owner sees the dry run while a dispute is open.
impact.footnote: While a dispute is open the milestone is held. Nobody edits the penalty by hand: the amount is recomputed after the dispute closes.

decision.title: Handle the dispute

RESOLVE.name: Close the dispute
RESOLVE.description: Records a resolution for each open dispute; the milestone is re-evaluated at once.

REQUEST_INFO.name: Request info
REQUEST_INFO.description: A note to the party who opened it; the dispute stays open and the milestone held.

OPEN.name: Open a new dispute
OPEN.description: Records DISPUTE_OPENED. The milestone is held until the buyer closes it validly.

note.label: Reason
note.placeholder: Describe the issue, supporting evidence and resolution (up to 2,000 characters).
note.demo: Demo note: compare the delivery scope and provide relevant documents before handling the dispute.

decision.readOnly: You can only view the disputes of this milestone.
decision.rule: "Easy to open, hard to close": every DISPUTE_OPENED blocks payment; only a DISPUTE_RESOLVED by the buyer (or its contract owner), referencing that dispute and not earlier than it, lifts the block.
